maddeler.e:
ألتبس (form VIII)
# أَلْتَبِسُ (ʔaltabisu) /ʔal.ta.bi.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
# أُلْتَبَسُ (ʔultabasu) /ʔul.ta.ba.su/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
# أَلْتَبِسَ (ʔaltabisa) /ʔal.ta.bi.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
# أُلْتَبَسَ (ʔultabasa) /ʔul.ta.ba
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
